decks.notes: This deck revolves around using various artifacts and lands to generate mana and create a powerful board presence. The key strategy involves assembling specific combinations of cards, such as The One Ring and Blade of the Bloodchief, to fuel powerful creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Basking Broodscale. By using cards like Springleaf Drum and Grove of the Burnwillows to ramp up mana quickly, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Pithing Needle and Boseiju, Who Endures provides additional utility and protection for the combo pieces.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently through spells like Manamorphose, Desperate Ritual, and Ruby Medallion to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames. It utilizes cards like Reckless Impulse and Wrenn's Resolve to draw through the deck quickly and find combo pieces. The deck aims to chain spells together, generate card advantage, and eventually win the game through a big turn with cards like Glimpse the Impossible and Wish. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces to overwhelm the opponent in a burst of storm-like spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and resources through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It employs graveyard recursion with Unearth and Thought Scour to maintain card advantage and tempo. The creatures in the deck serve multiple purposes, such as disrupting the opponent's strategy or providing card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's ability to consistently cast its spells while also providing access to various colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly with rituals and mana accelerators like Ruby Medallion, in order to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames. The aim is to quickly assemble the combo pieces to generate a large storm count and use cards like Reckless Impulse and Wrenn's Resolve to keep the combo going. Glimpse the Impossible and Elegant Parlor help to draw through the deck, while Wish allows for flexible access to key cards. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and burn effects.

This deck aims to control the game by ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Karn, the Great Creator. It uses cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy and Malevolent Rumble to clear the board. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration with cards like Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to quickly power out its high-cost threats. The inclusion of artifacts like The One Ring and Talisman of Impulse provide additional utility and flexibility in this ramp-focused control deck.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple, Talisman of Impulse, and Grove of the Burnwillows to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Defiler. The deck also uses cards like Through the Breach to cheat out big threats early in the game. Control elements like Chalice of the Void and Ugin's Labyrinth help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Return provide board wipes to clear the way for the Eldrazi onslaught. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with huge, game-ending threats.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through cards such as Desperate Ritual, Pyretic Ritual, and Manamorphose in order to cast a high volume of spells in a single turn. By utilizing cards like Glimpse the Impossible, Ral, Monsoon Mage, and Ruby Medallion, the deck aims to storm off and overwhelm the opponent with a big Grapeshot finish. The deck includes cards like Past in Flames and Wish to help with card advantage and to access key combo pieces. Overall, the deck is designed to execute a powerful combo in a fast-paced manner.

This UB Mill deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's library by using cards like Archive Trap, Fractured Sanity, and Glimpse the Unthinkable while also controlling the board with counterspells like Drown in the Loch and removal spells like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut. The deck also includes cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to consistently mill the opponent each turn. Surgical Extraction and Crypt Incursion are used to disrupt the opponent's strategy and gain advantage. The deck aims to mill the opponent's library as quickly as possible to win the game.

The deck focuses on cycling creatures and manipulating the graveyard to eventually cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that allows you to return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield. By cycling cards like Striped Riverwinder and Street Wraith, you can quickly fill your graveyard and set up for a game-winning Living End. The deck also utilizes cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation to control the board and protect your combo. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to efficiently cycle through your deck and set up for a devastating Living End resolution.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently ramp up mana using land tutors and bounce lands in order to quickly combo off with Primeval Titan and Scapeshift to bring out powerful lands like Valakut and Urza's Saga. The deck also utilizes Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and gain extra mana advantage. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful land-based combo win condition. The inclusion of cards like Cultivator Colossus and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove helps to improve consistency and flexibility in executing the combo.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and powerful spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional utility and consistency. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells, such as Thoughtseize and Static Prison, to control the board while pushing through damage. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth access to the necessary colors for casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a steady stream of threats to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing various counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards that interact with the graveyard, such as Cling to Dust and Unearth, to provide additional value and resources. Additionally, there are creatures like Harbinger of the Seas and Abhorrent Oculus that can help control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through attrition, utilizing the resources and disruption to stay ahead in the game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and get out Primeval Titan to search for lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and The Mycosynth Gardens to deal massive amounts of damage. With cards like Amulet of Vigor and Arboreal Grazer, the deck aims to generate a lot of mana quickly and combo off with cards like Scapeshift. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Vesuva allows for additional land tutoring and copying, while cards like Lotus Field and Gruul Turf provide additional mana sources. Overall, the deck focuses on comboing off and overwhelming the opponent with powerful land interactions.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to swarm the board with aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor, Ocelot Pride, and Guide of Souls, buffing them up with cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Static Prison and Galvanic Discharge, while also dealing direct damage with Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional value. The deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and overwhelming the opponent with a mix of creatures, removal, and combat tricks.

The main concept of the deck is to establish UrzaTron (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to quickly generate large amounts of mana to play powerful Eldrazi creatures and devastating spells. The deck focuses on controlling the board state with cards like All is Dust and Karn, the Great Creator, while using cards like Thought-Knot Seer and World Breaker to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and efficient removal spells, ultimately leading to victory through superior board presence and resource management.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells while utilizing The One Ring for additional value. The deck also utilizes Static Prison to control the opponent's resources and Goblin Bombardment for additional reach. With a lower curve and aggressive creature base, this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize. Companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional ramp and consistency to the deck's game plan.
